title: puner executor
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local isShowing = false

-- <<< Config UI Modern Style >>>
local FRAME_WIDTH_SCALE = 0.8
local FRAME_SIZE = UDim2.new(FRAME_WIDTH_SCALE, 0, 1, -60)
local FRAME_POSITION_HIDDEN = UDim2.new(1.1, 0, 0.5, 0)
local FRAME_POSITION_SHOW = UDim2.new(1 - FRAME_WIDTH_SCALE, 0, 0.5, 0)
local FRAME_ANCHOR = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
local CORNER_RADIUS = UDim.new(0.08, 0) 

-- สร้าง ScreenGui หลัก
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "ModernEditorUI"
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

-- =========================================================================
-- *** 1. Editor Frame หลัก (สไลด์จากขวา) ***
-- =========================================================================

local EditorFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
EditorFrame.Name = "ScriptEditor"
EditorFrame.Size = FRAME_SIZE
EditorFrame.Position = FRAME_POSITION_HIDDEN
EditorFrame.AnchorPoint = FRAME_ANCHOR
EditorFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30) 
EditorFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
EditorFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- *** ขอบโค้งมน, แสงขอบ, เส้นขอบ ***
local EditorCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
EditorCorner.CornerRadius = CORNER_RADIUS
EditorCorner.Parent = EditorFrame

local EditorGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
EditorGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 100)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60))
}
EditorGradient.Rotation = 90
EditorGradient.Parent = EditorFrame

local EditorStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
EditorStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 90) 
EditorStroke.Thickness = 1.5
EditorStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
EditorStroke.Parent = EditorFrame


-- =========================================================================
-- *** 2. Script Text Box ***
-- =========================================================================

local ScriptBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
ScriptBox.Name = "CodeInput"
ScriptBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
ScriptBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
ScriptBox.Text = "-- มึงใส่โค้ด Lua ตรงนี้\n-- เช่น loadstring(game:HttpGet('...'))()"
ScriptBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
ScriptBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
ScriptBox.MultiLine = true
ScriptBox.TextWrapped = true
ScriptBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
ScriptBox.TextSize = 16
ScriptBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
ScriptBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
ScriptBox.PlaceholderText = "Paste your Lua script here..."
ScriptBox.Parent = EditorFrame

local ScriptBoxCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ScriptBoxCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
ScriptBoxCorner.Parent = ScriptBox

-- =========================================================================
-- *** 3. Control Panel (ปุ่มควบคุมด้านล่าง) ***
-- =========================================================================

local ControlPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
ControlPanel.Name = "ControlPanel"
ControlPanel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
ControlPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
ControlPanel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
ControlPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20)
ControlPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
ControlPanel.BorderSizePixel = 0
ControlPanel.Parent = EditorFrame

local ControlLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ControlLayout.Name = "ControlLayout"
ControlLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
ControlLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
ControlLayout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
ControlLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 15)
ControlLayout.Parent = ControlPanel

-- ปุ่ม Execute (▶)
local ExecuteButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ExecuteButton.Name = "ExecuteButton"
ExecuteButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
ExecuteButton.Text = "▶"
ExecuteButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
ExecuteButton.TextSize = 30
ExecuteButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ExecuteButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
ExecuteButton.Parent = ControlPanel

local ExecuteCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ExecuteCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)
ExecuteCorner.Parent = ExecuteButton

-- *** ปุ่ม Save Script (💾) ***
local SaveButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
SaveButton.Name = "SaveButton"
SaveButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
SaveButton.Text = "💾"
SaveButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SaveButton.TextSize = 30
SaveButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
SaveButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 90, 180) -- สีน้ำเงิน
SaveButton.Parent = ControlPanel

local SaveCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
SaveCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)
SaveCorner.Parent = SaveButton

-- Logic การเซฟสคริปต์
SaveButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local codeToSave = ScriptBox.Text
    if codeToSave and codeToSave ~= "" then
        pcall(function()
            -- ใช้ SetClipboard เพื่อคัดลอกข้อความไปยังคลิปบอร์ด
            game:SetClipboard(codeToSave)
            print("ไอ้กวนตีน! สคริปต์ถูกเซฟลงคลิปบอร์ดแล้ว!")
            -- อัปเดต Placeholder เพื่อยืนยัน
            ScriptBox.PlaceholderText = "Script saved to clipboard!"
        end)
    else
        warn("ไม่พบสคริปต์ให้เซฟ!")
    end
end)
-- ***********************************

-- ปุ่ม Clear Script (🗑️)
local ClearButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ClearButton.Name = "ClearButton"
ClearButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
ClearButton.Text = "🗑️"
ClearButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ClearButton.TextSize = 30
ClearButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ClearButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)
ClearButton.Parent = ControlPanel

local ClearCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ClearCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 15)
ClearCorner.Parent = ClearButton

ClearButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ScriptBox.Text = ""
    ScriptBox.PlaceholderText = "Script Cleared! Paste your Lua script here..."
    print("Script Cleared!")
end)
-- ***********************************

-- =========================================================================
-- *** 4. ปุ่ม Toggle (P) และ Puner Executor Label ***
-- =========================================================================

local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Name = "EditorToggleButton"
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 55)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.97, 0, 0.03, 0)
ToggleButton.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
ToggleButton.Text = "P" -- เปลี่ยนเป็นตัว P
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.TextSize = 35
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local ToggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ToggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)
ToggleCorner.Parent = ToggleButton

-- *** UIGradient และ UIStroke สำหรับปุ่ม Toggle ***
local ToggleGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
ToggleGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 120)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 180)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 120))
}
ToggleGradient.Rotation = 45
ToggleGradient.Parent = ToggleButton

local ToggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ToggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 150)
ToggleStroke.Thickness = 1
ToggleStroke.Parent = ToggleButton

-- *** TextLabel "Puner Executor" ใต้ปุ่ม Toggle ***
local PunerHubLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
PunerHubLabel.Name = "PunerExecutorLabel" -- เปลี่ยนชื่อตรงนี้
PunerHubLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 15) -- ขยายขนาดนิดหน่อยเพื่อรองรับชื่อที่ยาวขึ้น
PunerHubLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.97, 0, 0.03, 55) -- ตำแหน่งอยู่ใต้ปุ่ม P
PunerHubLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0) 
PunerHubLabel.Text = "Puner Executor" -- เปลี่ยนข้อความตรงนี้
PunerHubLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
PunerHubLabel.TextSize = 14
PunerHubLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
PunerHubLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
PunerHubLabel.Parent = ScreenGui


-- ฟังก์ชันเปิด/ปิด Editor
ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isShowing = not isShowing
    local targetPosition = isShowing and FRAME_POSITION_SHOW or FRAME_POSITION_HIDDEN

    -- เลื่อน Editor เข้า/ออกทางด้านขวา
    TweenService:Create(
        EditorFrame,
        TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
        {Position = targetPosition}
    ):Play()
    
    -- Tween สีปุ่ม Toggle 
    local targetColor = isShowing and Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
    TweenService:Create(
        ToggleButton,
        TweenInfo.new(0.2),
        {BackgroundColor3 = targetColor}
    ):Play()
    
    -- Tween สี Gradient ของปุ่ม Toggle
    local targetGradientColors = isShowing and ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
    } or ColorSequence.new{
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 120)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 180)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 120))
    }
    TweenService:Create(
        ToggleGradient,
        TweenInfo.new(0.2),
        {Color = targetGradientColors}
    ):Play()
end)

-- =========================================================================
-- *** 5. Logic การรันโค้ด ***
-- =========================================================================

ExecuteButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local codeToRun = ScriptBox.Text

    if pcall(loadstring, codeToRun) then
        local success, result = pcall(loadstring(codeToRun))
        if success then
            print("ไอ้กวนตีน! โค้ดมึงรันเสร็จแล้ว!")
        else
            warn("รันโค้ดไม่สำเร็จ: " .. result)
            ScriptBox.Text = ScriptBox.Text .. "\n-- ERROR: " .. result
        end
    else
        warn("ไม่สามารถใช้ loadstring ในสภาพแวดล้อมนี้ได้ (Roblox ปกติบล็อก)")
        ScriptBox.Text = ScriptBox.Text .. "\n-- WARNING: loadstring() is restricted here."
    end
end)
